name: Compute Certification
description: Private release-only Agent for certifying Galactic Compute admission and isolation.

fixture_identity.description: Returns deterministic fixture identity and scenario metadata without starting Compute.

run_compute_certification.description: Starts, reads, or cancels one fixed Galactic Compute certification scenario.

action.description: Closed operation: start, status, or cancel

scenario.description: Reviewed scenario id; required only for start

marker.description: Canonical public release marker; accepted only by async_echo

artifact_id.description: Existing Compute artifact UUID; accepted only by artifact_consumer

expected_sha256.description: Expected lowercase SHA-256; accepted only by artifact_consumer

run_id.description: Compute run UUID; required only for status or cancel

returns.description: Raw public Compute start, status, or cancellation projection

run_compute_policy_probe.description: Starts one fixed bounded Compute probe for managed-routine policy certification.

routines.label: Compute policy certification
routines.description: Paused managed-routine target for certifying the Policy Pillar before Compute admission.
